# Pardalos Photos & Videos

> Professional photography and videography studio based in Afantou, Rhodes, Greece.

## Core services
- Wedding photography and videography in Rhodes, Greece
- Baptism photography and videography
- Couples and love story photography
- Family photography and holiday portrait sessions
- Event photography and videography
- Airbnb, villa and real estate photography
- Travel and destination photography
- Drone video coverage
